title: AI Team Headshots for Your About Page | AIVideosUGC
description: Make AI team headshots with the same light and backdrop for everyone. Each person uploads their own photo, so your About page looks tidy. Start with yours.
h1: AI Team Headshots That Match, from Founder to New Hire
lead: Give everyone on your team a polished headshot in the same bright office setting, each one made from that person's own photo.
intro: The example shows a smiling team member in a black blazer, framed from the chest up in a bright office with a plant and soft daylight behind her.

Small shops often have a Team or About page with photos taken years apart in different rooms. Matching headshots make that page look tidy and help customers put a face to the people who pack their orders and answer their emails. The Team Headshots template works best when each person uploads a recent photo and you use one setting description for everyone.
tip: Ask each person for a front-facing photo in daylight with nothing covering their face, and paste the same setting description for every headshot.

overview.h2: Give a Small Team One Visual Home
overview.p: Customers often meet a shop through its About page, support email, or founder profile before they visit a product page. Matching portraits make those touchpoints feel connected, even when each person starts with a different phone photo.
Use one backdrop, crop, light direction, and clothing level for the group. Keep each person's face supplied by that person and review every result privately before you publish it.

items.d: Use a recent photo shared by the person shown, with their agreement for the intended business use.
Choose a front-facing head-and-shoulders frame in daylight, without sunglasses, hats, or a hand covering the face.
Choose the backdrop, jacket level, crop, and light once, then reuse the same description for everyone.
A bright office wall, workshop corner, or plain warm surface keeps the portrait readable beside the next person.

results.h2: Places a Matching Portrait Can Help

Download the image for business pages or social posts after the person approves the result.
